nodes.name: make-self-upgrade.sts.yaml
nodes.summary: Chainguard Security Token Service policy granting write access to contents, pull requests, and workflows for the automated self-upgrade workflow on main branches.

nodes.name: renovate.sts.yaml
nodes.summary: Chainguard STS policy that lets the Renovate bot obtain GitHub tokens with contents, issues, pull request, and workflow permissions on main branches.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated file; permissions are scoped to a subject_pattern matching main/master refs.

nodes.name: renovate.json5
nodes.summary: Renovate configuration that extends the cert-manager shared preset, adds custom regex managers for base images and kind versions, and restricts update types on release branches.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON5 syntax allows comments and unquoted keys, used for Renovate's configuration format.

nodes.name: app.go
nodes.summary: Builds the acmesolver cobra command that runs the HTTP-01 challenge solver with graceful shutdown on context cancellation.
nodes.languageNotes: Go cobra command wiring with a goroutine that waits for context cancellation and shuts down the HTTP server with a 5 second timeout.

nodes.name: NewACMESolverCommand
nodes.summary: Constructs the acmesolver cobra command, registering listen-port, domain, token, and key flags and running the solver until shutdown.

nodes.name: go.mod
nodes.summary: Go module definition for the acmesolver binary, pinning cobra, component-base, and a replace directive that points the cert-manager dependency at the repository root.
nodes.languageNotes: Separate Go module per binary with a relative replace directive to the root module.

nodes.name: go.sum
nodes.summary: Go module checksum database for acmesolver dependencies, ensuring reproducible builds and supply-chain integrity.

nodes.name: main.go
nodes.summary: Entry point of the acmesolver binary that initializes logging, sets up graceful shutdown, and executes the acmesolver cobra command.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the shared internal cmd util exit handler so the process exits with an appropriate status code.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Sets up the exit handler and logger context, builds the acmesolver command, and reports execution errors with a non-zero exit code.
